dynamical_variables.R_H: varied cosmological/background modulus on the zero-input branch; frozen external anchor only on an explicitly finite-input branch
dynamical_variables.q_Lr(tau): moving-seam shape-harmonic coordinates selected by the periodic BVP/Floquet solution
dynamical_variables.seam_X: variational output of the global parent-child solution
dynamical_variables.x=log(R_child/R_parent): global nesting coordinate varied in the envelopment Euler-Lagrange system
